In around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a '''skirmish''' occurred within the [[Blue Star Centre]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the liberation of the Centre's inhabitants after they were taken hostage by members of the [[Intarsa League]].
